title: Fix Amplify ConsoleChatResponder Docker build Docker Hub rate limit

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Implementing fix in dashboard/amplify/functions/consoleRunWorker/Dockerfile: replace docker.io base image with AWS Public ECR mirror to avoid anonymous Docker Hub rate limits in Amplify CI builds.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Implemented and pushed fix on branch bugfix/amplify-consoleworker-dockerhub-rate-limit (commit ae3990212) and opened PR #395 to develop: https://github.com/AnthusAI/Plexus/pull/395.
